features.name: Create Tasks
features.description: Users can add new tasks with a title and optional description.
user_stories: As a user, I can create a task with a title so that I can record work I need to do.
As a user, I can add an optional description so that I can capture task details.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the task list, When I submit a valid title, Then the new task appears in my list as incomplete.
Given I submit an empty title, When I try to save, Then the system shows a validation error and creates no task.

features.name: Complete Tasks
features.description: Users can mark tasks as complete or reopen them.
user_stories: As a user, I can mark a task as complete so that I can track my progress.
As a user, I can reopen a completed task so that I can correct mistakes.
acceptance_criteria: Given an incomplete task, When I mark it complete, Then it is shown as completed and the change persists after reload.
Given a completed task, When I reopen it, Then it returns to the incomplete state.

features.name: Delete Tasks
features.description: Users can permanently delete tasks they no longer need.
user_stories: As a user, I can delete a task so that my list contains only relevant items.
As a user, I am asked to confirm deletion so that I do not remove tasks by accident.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing task, When I confirm deletion, Then the task is removed from my list and the database.
Given I cancel the delete confirmation, When the dialog closes, Then the task remains unchanged.

features.name: View and Filter Tasks
features.description: Users can view their task list and filter by status.
user_stories: As a user, I can view all my tasks so that I know what needs attention.
As a user, I can filter by active or completed so that I can focus on relevant tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Given I have tasks, When I open the app, Then I see only my own tasks sorted by newest first.
Given I select the Completed filter, When the list refreshes, Then only completed tasks are displayed.

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Users can register and log in so that their tasks remain private.
user_stories: As a visitor, I can register an account so that I can store my tasks securely.
As a user, I can log in and out so that only I can access my task list.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid registration details, When I submit the form, Then an account is created and I am logged in.
Given incorrect credentials, When I attempt to log in, Then access is denied and an error message is shown.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Task list pages load in under 2 seconds with 100 concurrent users.
Passwords are hashed with bcrypt and all traffic is served over HTTPS.
Users can create a task in no more than 2 interactions from the main screen.
Each user can access only their own tasks; cross-user access attempts return HTTP 403.
